tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background — the warm paper ground under every template. textPrimary 17:1, textSecondary 4.84:1 on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised white plane: the 'light' media placeholder tone, skip-link panel and any inset sheet. Never the page ground.

tokens.name: textPrimary
tokens.usage: Headlines, body copy, links, CTAs, eyebrow labels and the 2px focus outline — on canvas (17:1), surface (18.9:1) and support (13:1).

tokens.name: textSecondary
tokens.usage: Meta, captions, leads, default CategoryNav items and input borders — on canvas (4.84:1) and surface (5.36:1) only. On support it is 3.68:1: use textPrimary there.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines that divide sections (header bottom, footer top) and the default media-placeholder ground. Decorative only — never a control boundary.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Red in small doses, as lines and decorative marks only: the 16×2px rule before eyebrows, the 2px Selected underline in CategoryNav, the 2px CTA hover underline, the small square on the cover. Never text (12px text would be 4.19:1 on canvas, below AA) and never a large fill. Marks hold 3:1+ on canvas (4.19:1) and surface (4.64:1).

tokens.name: support
tokens.usage: Mint support plane: QuoteBlock ground and the 'mint' media-placeholder tone. Text on it is textPrimary only.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: [derived-extension] Dialog / AlertDialog backdrop only: textPrimary #111111 at 48% over the page. The one token added for the IAK coverage families; never a surface, text or border colour.

groups.name: Serif
groups.note: Display and heading only. Figma: Noto Serif KR Medium. Web: Georgia, then Noto Serif KR if installed. Mobile (<768): display 40/44, heading 32/40.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page: the FeatureStory / page-intro headline. Mobile 40/44.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section heads, story sub-heads and QuoteBlock text. Mobile 32/40.

groups.name: Sans
groups.note: Titles, body and navigation. Figma: Inter. Web: Arial, then Noto Sans KR if installed — glyph widths differ from Inter, so line breaks can differ between Figma and the web.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: StoryCard titles and the text brand in header/footer.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 빛과 사물, 그리고 일상에서 발견한 새로운 시선을 모읍니다.
styles.usage: Running text, leads, navigation links and CTAs (CTA at 600).

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: ArticleMeta, ImageCaption and footer notes in textSecondary; eyebrows in textPrimary (with the accent rule before them). Never in accent.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Hairline nudges; smallest optical adjustment.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: ImageCaption gap; caption top margin; label-to-field gap.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: StoryCard internal gap; ArticleMeta gap; mobile grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: CategoryNav and header gaps; desktop grid gutter; mobile page padding; QuoteBlock mobile padding; CTA label-to-arrow gap.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Tablet page padding; section-head bottom margin; footer vertical padding; mobile gap between stacked stories.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Desktop page padding; FeatureStory column gap; QuoteBlock padding; mobile section rhythm.

tokens.name: space-72
tokens.usage: Desktop section rhythm (section top/bottom padding, space after QuoteBlock).

tokens.name: space-96
tokens.usage: Large editorial pause between major bands on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-128
tokens.usage: Maximum pause — opening/closing whitespace on 1440 frames.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Default: square — sections, QuoteBlock, grids, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Media placeholders / images and form inputs — barely softened.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Ceiling. Small inset elements only; never exceed it.
